propositions: Diagnostic artifacts measuring completion-verifier runaway (transcript and matrix scripts, findings document) were committed to impl-10ae-verifier-ctx branch but never landed on main, making the ticket's evidence unverifiable against the main branch.

The three diagnostic artifacts should be landed on main as a standalone changeset because they follow an established convention in docs/experiments/ (paired driver scripts + findings write-ups), are reusable across future step-floor changes, and content-free by design (transcripts never committed).

Both diagnostic scripts depend only on surfaces that exist on main (pai_tools modules and completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS) and are parameterized for re-use, making them candidates for permanent inclusion rather than temporary branch artifacts.

The completion-verifier runaway loop remains reproducible on current main (observed tripping max_consecutive_repeat=12 guard at 66 requests) despite the landing of diagnostic evidence, indicating the underlying issue is not fixed but backstopped by the runaway guard.
